verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹ ਸੁ ਖੇਹ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਭੈ ਲਈ ਨਕੀਬੀ।
verses.translit_en: maanas dheh su kheh hai tis vich jeebhai liee nakeebee|

en.bdb: Human body is like ashes but in it the tongue is admirable (for its benefits).

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਕੰਨ ਕਰਨਿ ਰਕੀਬੀ।
verses.translit_en: akhee dhekhan roop ra(n)g raag naadh ka(n)n karan rakeebee|

en.bdb: The eyes behold forms and colours and the ears take care of the sounds- musical and otherwise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਕਿ ਸੁਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਪੰਜੇ ਦੂਤ ਬੁਰੀ ਤਰਤੀਬੀ।
verses.translit_en: nak suvaas nivaas hai pa(n)je dhoot buree tarateebee|

en.bdb: Nose is the abode of smell and thus all these five couriers (of the body) remain indulged in these pleasures (and become futile).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੂੰ ਨੀਵੇ ਚਰਣ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨਸੀਬੁ ਨਸੀਬੀ।
verses.translit_en: sabh dhoo(n) neeve charan hoi aap gavai naseeb naseebee|

en.bdb: Among these all, the feet are placed at the lowest level and they repudiating ego are fortunate.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਦਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰੈ ਤਬੀਬੀ।
verses.translit_en: haumai rog miTaidhaa satigur pooraa karai tabeebee|

en.bdb: The true Guru by giving treatment removes the malady of ego.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਨੀਬੀ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai raharaas kar gur sikh sun gursikh maneebee|

en.bdb: The true disciples of the Guru touch the feet and bow and abide by the instructions of the Guru.
He who becomes humble and dead to all desires is the true disciple.
